channel.title: Min Players: 1 on More Than Games
channel.description: Recent content in Min Players: 1 on More Than Games

item.title: Review: Animal Rescue Team (Play to Z)
item.description: When disaster strikes, first responders are there to help the people in danger. 10+, 1-4 players, 45 minutes

item.title: Review: Tangram City (Capstone Games)
item.description: The name on the box declares the game’s basic idea right from the start, but Uwe Rosenberg’s Tangram City from Capstone Games still keeps plenty of surprises under wraps. 8+, 1-5 players, 30 minutes

item.title: Review: Acquire 60th Anniversary (Renegade)
item.description: Sixty years is a big anniversary, whether it’s for a company or your favorite couple. 14+, 1-4 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Kinfire Chronicles: Night’s Fall (Incredible Dream)
item.description: Kinfire Chronicles: Night’s Fall by Incredible Dream Studios is the newest — and possibly largest, because this game is physically huge — installment in a series of titles set in the fantasy world of Atios. 14+, 1-4 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Distilled (Paverson Games)
item.description: You still can’t quite believe it, but the letter in your hands is very clear. 14+, 1-5 players, 30 minutes/player

item.title: Review: First Rat (Pegasus Spiele)
item.description: Everybody knows the moon is made of cheese — and for the comic book-reading rats of the local junkyard, it’s an article of faith. 10+, 1-5 players, 30-75 minutes

item.title: Review: Salton Sea (Devir Games)
item.description: In a time when global warming, alternative energy, and electric vehicles seem to be on everyone’s mind, the Salton Sea in California feels like a mirage. 14+, 1-4 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Express Route (The OP)
item.description: It’s 1959 in the alternate reality of Express Route from The OP, and catalog shopping is exploding throughout the US! 10+, 1-4 players, 60-90 minutes

item.title: Review: Dodos Riding Dinos (Detestable Games)
item.description: Life was calm and peaceful on Dodino Island — right up to the point when a meteor fell on the ruling dino and dodo, leaving the island without leadership. 14+, 1-6 players, 20 minutes

item.title: Review: Bonsai (DV Games)
item.description: There’s something magical about bonsai trees. 8+, 1-4 players, 40 minutes

item.title: Review: Lost Ruins of Arnak (Czech Games Edition)
item.description: The moment you set up this game on your table, you’ll feel teleported into your favorite archaeological adventure movie — most likely that series featuring the guy who runs away from giant boulders and can’t lose his hat no matter how hard he tries. 12+, 1-4 players, about 30 mins. per player

item.title: Review: The Loop (Pandasaurus Games)
item.description: Oh no! 12+, 1-4 players, 60 minutes

item.title: Review: Wild Space (Pandasaurus)
item.description: This review is a little late. 10+, 1-5 players, 3 to set up; 25-30 to play

item.title: Review: Cindr (Smirk and Dagger)
item.description: *“Looking for a dragon to light up your life? 14+, 1-5 players, 3 to set up; 25-30 to play

item.title: Review: Tiny Epic Dinosaurs (Gamelyn Games)
item.description: Don’t let the cute box art with playful dinosaurs and a sunny sky fool you. 14+, 1-4 players, 5 to set up, 30-60 to play

item.title: Review: Imperial Settlers: Empires of the North (Portal Games)
item.description: Welcome to the frozen north, where the land is cold, the penguins are friendly, the drink is plentiful, and the islands are up for grabs. 8+, 1-4 players, 8 to set up, 45-90 to play

item.title: Review: Nemo Rising: Robur the Conqueror (Wizkids)
item.description: Set in the world of C. 8+, 1-4 players, 10 to set up, 90 to play

item.title: Review: Clip Cut Parks (Renegade)
item.description: The city needs more parks, and it’s up to you to build them. 8+, 1-4 players, 3 to set up, 30 minutes to play

item.title: Review: My Little Scythe (Stonemaier Games)
item.description: My Little Scythe from Stonemaier Games launched from a moment every gaming parent faces: when your too-young-to-play child gets enthralled by your very-expensive-it’s-new-don’t-touch-that board game. 8+, 1-6 players, 4 to set up, 35-60 to play

item.title: Review: Kepler 3042 (Renegade)
item.description: Ah, the joy of running a galactic empire! 14+, 1-4 players, 10 to set up, 60-120 to play

item.title: Review: Pyramid Arcade (Looney Labs)
item.description: It all started with a short story. 8+, 1-10 players, 5 or less to set up, 10-120 to play

item.title: Review: The Colonists (Mayfair Games)
item.description: The word “epic” gets thrown around a lot in movies and books — epic adventures, epic battles, epic tales, and such — but we don’t see it applied very often in board games. 14+, 1-4 players, 10 to set up, 40-360 to play
